svg.title: Geothermal technician — Non-binary person
svg.desc: A fictional non-binary person working as geothermal technician, wearing coveralls and a hard hat. Visible work cue: A steam wellhead has a wide flange and round upper valve between two light rising steam curls. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a hard hat and round glasses.
